notes.title: Update 1.11
notes.notes:
Hello All!
Update 1.11 is now live. It is full of various quality of life things that I have been meaning to do.
I am releasing the game for free on IOS and Google Play and took the opportunity to fix some things. You can find the full list below. There will also be an upcoming price change for the game to make it cheaper just in an effort to get more people to check it out, I hope you enjoy!

- General Quality of Life Improvements
- Sword nerf (slightly longer cooldown)
- Lower price on multiple tier one upgrades to better reflect usefulness
- Daily reward system
- Retry button after you lose that restores health, gives gold, and skips the wave.
- Saving bug fixes 
- Heart display fix
- Better sound management to prevent clipping
- In App Shop (only on IOS and Google Play)

Thanks for playing the game! please contact me with any more bugs!

notes.title: air star Update 1.1
notes.notes:
[b]Update 1.1 is here![/b]
There is lots of new content to discover and a few of new cosmetics to get. Here is the changelog:

[list]
[*] 2 new levels (one unlocked on download)
[*] 17 new upgrades, 6 of which are unique towers with new synergies!
[*] 2 new ultimate upgrades
[*] 6 new hats
[*] 8 new frog skins
[*] 2 new planes
[/list]

Thank you to everyone who has played the game, and anyone who has left me a review! They help out a lot. 
Please let me know if anything is broken and I can fix it! I hope I have addressed most of the issues people where having. 

If you are interested in my games in general, want to bug me about mechanics or strategy, or want to share a game or piece of art you are working on, please feel free to join our discord! 
discord : https://discord.gg/ARdqegweJr 

Sharing the game to people you think would be interested is greatly appreciated.
